engine.name: The Thing Under Solmere
engine.what: Find out what the Guild has been keeping awake beneath the city.
engine.where: Solmere, and the Ninth Well below it
stages: The Guild will not say what the Engine House is for. Ask in Solmere.
The workings under the city are recent, not ancient. Somebody built them, and lately.
The Ferran Outpost was keeping something awake. Follow the power back to its source.
The Ninth Well is open, and something far below has answered the machinery.

after.name: Everything Is Still Here
after.what: The sky broke and the world did not end. Find out what is left, and who is still standing in it.
stages: The world is changed and the roads still go where they went. Walk them again and see who is left.

firstengine.name: The First Engine
firstengine.what: Answer the oldest question in the world, asked by the oldest thing in it.
firstengine.where: the deepest floor of the Ninth Well

idris.name: The Last Blade of Ashenhall
idris.what: Idris will travel with you if the hall is settled.

osric.name: Owner of the Vagrant Star
osric.what: Osric will come along once the table is square.

maret.name: The Broken Standard
maret.what: Maret has a countersign and no army left to give it to.

tam.name: Child of the Bramblewaste
tam.what: Something in the bramble has been following the party. It is a child.
tam.where: the road, once the world has broken

ilsabet.name: The Long Look
ilsabet.what: The apprentice painter wants to come, and her master will not say no twice.

kestrel.name: The Vellum Archivist
kestrel.what: Kestrel has read about everywhere and been nowhere.
kestrel.where: Solmere, once the world has broken

oda.name: The Still Water
oda.what: The grandmaster will teach you if you can stand in front of him.
oda.where: Marrow & Salt, the shop in Harrowmere

rusk.name: Salvaged
rusk.what: Eleven years against a wall. Somebody should ask it to move.

mask.name: Whoever It Needs To Be
mask.what: It has been in the party for a while. Nobody remembers when.

tincup.name: The Tin Cup
tincup.what: Vesna goes back to the roadside well, which is the only cold thing left.

quiet.name: The Quiet Lesson
quiet.what: Tam stops the party under the ridge to say something out loud.

gallery.name: The Heavy End
gallery.what: Bastian returns to the place he stopped lifting things for money.

vance.name: The Second Sword
vance.what: Idris has been carrying a blade that is not his.

vagrant.name: The Ledger Game
vagrant.what: Osric plays one more hand against the book he has been losing to.

countersign.name: The Countersign
countersign.what: Maret gives the word that stopped meaning anything.

portrait.name: The Long Look
portrait.what: Ilsabet paints one thing she has been putting off.

names.name: Sixty-One Names
names.what: Kestrel finishes a list nobody asked for.
names.where: Solmere, once the world has broken

stillwater.name: The Ninth Form
stillwater.what: Oda shows the form he does not teach.

relief.name: Stand Down
relief.what: Somebody finally relieves Rusk of a post nobody assigned.

eighth.name: The Eighth Name
eighth.what: Wick has been leaving one name off the litany.

mask_habit.name: The Reflection
mask_habit.what: The Mask looks at something for longer than it usually does.

pump.name: The Pump
pump.what: Aurelian repairs the first machine he ever built badly.

ashby.name: Corvin's Debt
ashby.what: A name from before the Guild wants settling.

debt.name: The Fen Barrow Debt
debt.what: Somebody in the barrow is owed, and has waited.

lantern.name: The Ninth Lantern
lantern.what: A lantern that has never gone out is going out.

tally.name: Forty-One Marks
tally.what: Someone cut a tally into the well rim and then stopped.

barrow.name: The Fen Barrow
barrow.what: The barrow has been opened from the inside.

oak.name: The Standing Oak
oak.what: The oak has not moved in nine hundred years and is moving.
oak.where: off the road, west of Harrowmere

baron.name: The Toll Baron
baron.what: Someone has started charging for a road that was never his.

pass.name: The Pass
pass.what: The high pass is shut and the reason is not snow.

thaw.name: The Thaw
thaw.what: Cinderspine is thawing eight weeks early.

shelf.name: The Shelf
shelf.what: A ledge at Highfell is carrying more than it should.

wood.name: The Weeping Answer
wood.what: The wood answers, which it has not done before.

moot.name: The Moot
moot.what: Verrenholt cannot agree on a thing it has agreed on for two centuries.

millwheel.name: The Millwheel
millwheel.what: The wheel turns and the mill does not.

surveyor.name: The Surveyor's Rota
surveyor.what: A survey was filed for ground that is not there.

postbag.name: The Last Postbag
postbag.what: One bag of letters never reached anyone. Deliver it.
stages: Three letters in the bag and nobody left on the round to carry them.
One delivered. Two names still in the bag.
Two delivered. One name still in the bag.
All three delivered. There is something else at the bottom of the bag.
The fourth letter read. It was never going to be posted.

withies.name: The Withies
withies.what: The withies go in every spring or the channel walks.

cabinet.name: The Cabinet of Species
cabinet.what: A collection with one drawer that will not close.

count.name: The Sealer of Weights
count.what: Oxmere's weights do not agree with each other any more.
stages: Every weight in Oxmere is a little light, and all by different amounts.
The chalk bar read. Somebody has been recording the drift for years.
The weighing beam lit. The drift is not in the weights.

hurdles.name: The Last Hurdler
hurdles.what: One man still makes hurdles the old way and cannot say why.

droveroad.name: The Drove Road
droveroad.what: The drove road has a warning on it in a hand nobody recognises.

lodge.name: The Lodge Notice
lodge.what: A notice at Caldwick has been up for four hours and eleven years.
stages: The notice on the lodge door names an hour, and no day.
The notice read. Somebody has been keeping the fourth hour.
The cord runs into the wall and stops being a cord.
The flue is open. It goes further than the chimney does.
The far end of the flue found, and what was using it.

apron.name: The Cold Apron
apron.what: The forge apron at Caldwick is cold in the middle of a working day.

rent.name: The Undercroft Rent
rent.what: Somebody is paying rent on a room under Marrowgate.

pitch.name: Eight Yards of Pitch
pitch.what: Eight yards of pitch, ordered and never collected.

relic.name: The Hand
relic.what: A relic in Marrowgate has been handled recently.

ford.name: The Ford
ford.what: The Greyharrow ford is passable and should not be.

indenture.name: The Indenture
indenture.what: A contract at Greyharrow outlived everyone who signed it.

inventory.name: The Miscellaneous Drawer
inventory.what: Everything that did not fit a category ended up here.

bailey.name: The Bailey
bailey.what: Duncastle keeps a bailey it will not open.

sixlines.name: Six Lines
sixlines.what: The Duncastle roll is six lines longer than the muster.

account.name: The Account
account.what: The Ninth Well keeps an account of something uncountable.

record.name: The Well Reads Back
record.what: Speak into the well and it answers with your own record.

alcove.name: The Cleaned Alcove
alcove.what: Somebody has been cleaning an alcove at Ashenhall.

choir.name: The Choir Under Ashenhall
choir.what: There is singing below the hall and nobody down there.

caravan.name: The Caravan
caravan.what: A caravan left Emberlyn and did not arrive anywhere.

eastroad.name: The East Road
eastroad.what: The east road out of Emberlyn is being maintained by no one.

barge.name: The Lime Barge
barge.what: A lime barge is tied up at Lowfen with a full hold.

carriage.name: The Last Carry
carriage.what: One more fare out of Lowfen, and the driver knows it.

carter.name: The Carter's Pass
carter.what: A carter needs a pass that no office still issues.

circuit.name: The Circuit
circuit.what: The Thornmarch circuit has been walked out of order.

covenant.name: The Covenant
covenant.what: Thistlebeck keeps a covenant nobody will read aloud.

lighthouse.name: The Light Relit
lighthouse.what: The coast light has been dark for a season.

lowerstorey.name: The Lower Storey
lowerstorey.what: The Drowned Halls have a floor below the floor.

hours.name: The Hours
hours.what: The Sunken Vault keeps hours that do not match the sun.

office.name: The Office
office.what: Somebody at the Last Lantern is still keeping office hours.

coldforge.name: The Cold Forge
coldforge.what: A forge at the Last Lantern that has never been lit.

pyre.name: Kingspyre Relit
pyre.what: The pyre at the top of the world wants relighting.

yard.name: The Yardmaster
yard.what: Bramblewold has a yardmaster and no yard.

brood.name: The Brood of Glass
brood.what: Something is laying in the Glasswaste.

pane.name: The Standing Pane
pane.what: A single sheet of glass is standing upright in open ground.

sump.name: The Sump That Drank
sump.what: The great sump took a season of rain and asked for more.

tenth.name: The Tenth Well
tenth.what: There were nine wells. There is a tenth.

measure.name: The Last Measure
measure.what: The last honest measure in the Reach, and who is holding it.

gainsay.name: The Gainsayer
gainsay.what: Something on the downs contradicts whatever is said near it.

eleven.name: The Eleventh Hour
eleven.what: A clock in the Reach strikes eleven and stops.
